summary: Partial read-only reviews of solr-operator PRs 827 and 879. PR 827 has source-derived concerns: arbitrary custom exporter tags with a numeric major >=10 are rejected as Solr 10, and rejecting a SolrCloud image tag stops all status refresh including readyReplicas. PR 879's namespace/name indexing addresses the known cross-namespace watch; its test needs compatible tags and combined transition coverage with PR 827.
verification: Source-only; no local build, Go tests or Kubernetes execution. PR 827 has no reported GitHub checks at captured head; PR 879 reports green lint/unit, smoke and Solr 9.11 e2e checks. No public comments or code changes.
